jobs.description:
Does the idea of working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment excite you? Are you an ambitious individual with a strong interest in energy markets? Then you might be our new Junior Gas Trader!

As a Junior Gas Trader at Nitor Energy, you will play a key role in an established commodity trading desk and contribute to our common goal – always being the best at what we do! As part of our gas team, you will trade gas across Europe as well as developing and improving trading strategies.

This role is ideal for someone who is finalizing their master’s degree (or a recent graduate) and is eager to challenge the status quo of the energy sector. No prior experience in the industry is required – we are ready to teach you everything you need to know and help you grow. However, being analytical, reflective, and quick on your feet is essential to excel in this role.

Let’s dive into the details!

Your responsibilities will include

• Trading European gas like a strategy game, where every decision counts

• Analyzing real-time market data to spot opportunities and make winning trades. Think of it as solving a puzzle where the pieces keep moving

• Developing and executing trading strategies in a fast-paced, competitive environment

• Managing risk and reward

• Keeping an eye on market trends, news, and data to stay ahead of the competition

• Balancing quick ad hoc tasks with bigger quantitative projects, all aimed at improving your trading performance

• Collaborating with your team to refine strategies and share insights

What we’re looking for

• You are currently finalizing your master’s degree in finance, business, mathematics, physics or similar (or have recently graduated)

• You are a true team player with a positive mindset and ready to participate in our 24/7/365 shift setup

• You hold strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• You have an executing mindset and are confident in making quick decisions both independently and as part of a team

• You have a winning mentality and are willing to go the extra mile to challenge the status quo

• You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same, and where your team members are always tossing you the ball – figuratively and literally – so you must be ready to catch it!

What we offer

• A young, dynamic, ambitious and fun work environment

• Extensive opportunities for personal development and career growth. You will be given responsibility from day one and receive close sparring with skilled colleagues

• The opportunity to contribute and make your mark on a young company’s development

• A competitive salary package

• A fun and social work environment with regular team events and social activities throughout the year. We also offer weekly sports activities to strengthen team spirit, including our Nitor running club.

• Delicious lunch arrangement with food from Meyers in our own canteen

• Brand new office facilities located in the heart of Aarhus, right next to Dokk1 and Letbanen

Expected start date: Flexible within the next 6 months

About Nitor Energy

Nitor Energy is a fast-growing energy trading company, that has swiftly transitioned from start-up to scale-up within just a few years. We’re experiencing rapid growth, offering limitless opportunities for learning and development. We’re proud of who we are and excited about what we’re building for the future together. Our employees thrive on challenges and are motivated by the potential that lies ahead.

Our unique culture integrates traders, coders, and analysts into cohesive teams, creating a well-rounded approach to our success. We believe in a balanced work-life dynamic and foster a vibrant, engaging atmosphere where our employees can excel in every aspect.

Apply now

Kasper Aarhus Hansen

Head of Short Term Gas Trading & Operations

kah@nitorenergy.com

jobs.occupation: AI Scientist: Generative Modeling of Inorganic Materials
jobs.description:
About Us

We are a pioneering materials discovery company headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark. Our mission is to accelerate the design and discovery of advanced, sustainable materials by leveraging cutting-edge simulation tools and self-driving labs.

We are dedicated to bridging the gap between scientific breakthroughs and practical, real-world applications. Join our dynamic, international, and diverse team where collaboration and innovation are at the heart of innovating for a sustainable future, one material at a time.

Role Overview

We are seeking an ambitious AI Scientist to take the lead in developing and deploying a state-of-the-art generative model for inorganic materials.

This is a high-impact role where your work will directly contribute to our core materials design pipeline, enabling the accelerated design of in-demand materials. You will have the unique opportunity to see the models you develop move from concept to real-world industrial application.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Develop and deploy advanced generative models, focusing on state-of-the-art techniques such as autoregressive, diffusion- and flow-based ML models.

• 
Collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of materials scientists, computer scientists, and scientific software developers.

• 
Solve complex, real-world problems in materials design, drastically speeding up the discovery process.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

We are looking for candidates who demonstrate proven capability in generative AI and a passion for scientific applications.

• 
Generative Modeling Expertise: A demonstrated experience in generative modeling within academic or industrial settings, particularly with advanced methods like autoregressive, diffusion-, or flow-based models.

• 
Technical Proficiency: Strong expertise in Computer Science, Python and deep learning frameworks.

• 
Scientific Application: Experience applying generative models to scientific domains, preferably in materials science.

• 
Communication: Excellent communication skills, capable of conveying complex technical information clearly and concisely to diverse teams.

• 
Drive & Detail: A strong self-starter mentality with strong attention to detail and eager to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and technical setting.

Preferred Skills:

These qualifications are a strong plus, demonstrating your readiness for the role:

• 
Advanced Degree: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, or a related field.

• 
Publication Record: A strong publication record showcasing the design and implementation of novel generative models.

• 
Computational Materials Science: Experience with computational materials science methods, such as DFT (Density Functional Theory) and MD (Molecular Dynamics).

• 
Domain Familiarity: Familiarity with common experimental techniques for materials synthesis and characterization.

What We Offer

• 
High-Growth Environment: A unique opportunity to be part of one of the most promising start-ups in materials discovery on an ambitious path to achieve unicorn status.

• 
Impactful Mission: Involvement in solving some of the world’s most complex challenges, directly supporting a greener and more sustainable future.

• 
Financial Upside: Possibility to enter our warrant program at an early stage.

• 
Culture: A welcoming, diverse, and entrepreneurial workplace located in vibrant Copenhagen, Denmark.

• 
Work Style: A vibrant atmosphere with a flat hierarchy, open collaboration, and active idea-sharing.

• 
Fuel: Free coffee, snacks, and even a massage chair to power your creative energy! 😉

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to manage, assist and consult our customers on the DACH market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we manage our customers now and going forward.

About Pandektes

Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than €4 million and most recently closed a €2.9 million seed round (Feb 2025) led by People Ventures, Interface Capital, and leading angels. Pandektes already serves more than 400 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

About the role

You will join our current team of three in Customer Success to work on serving our German-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

What you’ll do

• 
Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

• 
Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

• 
Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

• 
Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

What you’ll bring

• 
Fluency in German and English

• 
Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

• 
2+ years of experience in customer success

• 
Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

• 
Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

• 
Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• 
Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

• 
Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

How we work

We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

What we offer

• 
A central role in a fast-growing company with €4M+ raised, most recently a €2.9M seed led by People Ventures and Interface Capital

• 
International team events - last time we went to Barcelona, and we'd love to have you join us next time 🌍

• 
Flexible work - from the office or home 🏡

• 
We take work-life balance seriously and well-being is one of our values

• 
25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• 
Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses 💳

• 
Paid parental leave

With the increasing amount of legislation and case law, legal professionals are required to navigate more data than ever before. Pandektes is designed to simplify this process using artificial intelligence, intelligent search functions, and updated legal sources. Our vision is clear: to be the leading platform for legal information retrieval, enabling in-depth and accurate legal knowledge in a fast, efficient and user-friendly way using artificial intelligence.

jobs.occupation: Director Position | Strategy & Transaction Services – Kvadrant Consulting
jobs.description:
Director in Strategy & Transaction practise

Kvadrant Consulting is seeking Management Consultants with experience in Commercial Due Diligence and Value Realization programs for PE owned companies

What we do

Driven by technology and changing buyer behavior, sales and marketing are undergoing significant change.

At Kvadrant Consulting, we operate at the forefront of this shift and believe yesterday’s answers rarely apply in today’s digitally enabled reality.

We help senior leaders design and run their commercial functions to accelerate growth. As part of the Elixirr Group, we combine deep commercial expertise with access to advanced data, AI, and digital capabilities. We are a focused team of passionate consultants, now looking to expand.

About the role

As a Director at Kvadrant Consulting, you will play a key role in building and scaling our Strategy & Transaction practise. You will work closely with partners, investors, and portfolio company leadership teams to shape commercial strategies across the full ownership lifecycle, from target screening and commercial due diligence to post-acquisition value creation.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Leading and delivering commercial due diligence projects (buy- and sell-side) for private equity clients.

• 
Advising PE funds and portfolio company leadership on commercial value creation initiatives pre- and post-acquisition.

• 
Leading market assessments, customer analyses, and competitive benchmarking to support investment decisions.

• 
Facilitating senior-level workshops and discussions with investors, boards, and executive teams.

• 
Contributing to the development of Kvadrant’s PE offering, methodologies, and thought leadership.

• 
Coaching and developing junior consultants while working closely with partners on client engagements.

• 
Building, landing and maintaining your own pipeline of projects and customers

Who we are looking for

You are a high performer with strong analytical and commercial acumen. You enjoy working in small, dynamic teams and have a proactive, results-driven mindset.

You are eager to help investors and B2B companies realize their full commercial potential.

The ideal candidate:

• Has at least 3 years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an in-house consulting role.

• Holds a master’s degree with outstanding results.

• Possesses strong analytical, strategic, and commercial skills.

• Can engage with and advise senior leaders with confidence and empathy.

• Has at least three years of experience in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or an in-house consulting role

What we offer

• As a Director at Kvadrant Consulting, you will gain a high level of responsibility and be linked directly to one of our partners.

• You will build and expand the classic management consultant toolbox while gaining practical experience supporting partners on client projects.

• For the passionate commercial profile that is ready to take on more responsibility through direct client exposure and test themselves in a high–performance environment, this is the perfect opportunity.

• We also offer a development path towards partnership if the fit is right, and your performance is high.

• We pride ourselves on having a culture and workplace where people love to come to work. We spend time together beyond work and prioritize plenty of social events, such as strategy–getaways and internal training.

• We strive to ensure you have a great work-life balance and a high degree of flexibility regarding where and when you work.

• Our commitment is embodied by our office’s collaborative, welcoming and ambient atmosphere that is placed in the heart of Copenhagen.

Why Kvadrant

We believe the best commercial work is done close to the business, with curiosity, rigor, and respect for the people involved.

Kvadrant Consulting is a Copenhagen-based consultancy focused on commercial transformation for global B2B companies. We help sales and marketing leaders turn strategy into lasting execution.

Part of the Elixirr Group, we combine specialist focus with access to data, AI, and digital capabilities – delivering depth and scale where it matters.

What sets us apart:

• 
A focused commercial transformation agenda, no unrelated side projects

• 
A culture built on high ambition and low ego

• 
Strong investment in people development and learning

• 
A collaborative, welcoming office in the heart of Copenhagen

We aim to be the leading consultancy within B2B sales and marketing, and we believe this is achieved through long-term investment in people, culture, and quality of work.

Apply for the role

Please upload your CV, Cover Letter, and other documents below. If you would like to learn more about the position, feel free to contact Nønne Jørgensen at nbj@kvadrant.dk.

jobs.occupation: Management Consultant – Commercial Strategy & AI | Kvadrant
jobs.description:
What we do

Buyer behavior is changing fast, and the companies that win are the ones that turn data into commercial decisions, not just dashboards.

At Kvadrant Consulting, we help senior leaders redesign how their sales and marketing functions operate, so they can grow smarter and faster.

As part of the Elixirr Group, we combine deep commercial expertise with advanced data and digital capabilities. We work with B2B companies on the questions that matter: how to allocate marketing spend, how to translate CRM insight into pipeline, and how to build the commercial infrastructure that scales.

About the role

B2B go-to-market is being rebuilt. AI is compressing sales cycles, reshaping buyer journeys, and turning data quality from a nice-to-have into a growth constraint. Most companies understand the opportunity. Few know how to capture it. This role sits at that gap.

As a Management Consultant in our GTM practice, you will help senior commercial leaders redesign how they go to market: how they segment, prioritise, and engage customers, and how they use technology and data to do it at scale.

You will work directly with a partner from day one, across a portfolio of B2B clients spanning multiple industries.

Your background is in growth. You have 2–4 years of experience operating inside a commercial function or building GTM systems as a practitioner. You understand what it actually takes to move revenue.

At Kvadrant, you will bring that experience into the consulting context and build on it: adding structured problem solving, project management, executive facilitation, and the full management consultant toolbox to what you already know.

Your primary tasks include

• Design and assess AI-enabled GTM models across segmentation, pipeline management, and customer engagement

• Analyse commercial data to identify growth levers and prioritisation logic

• Translate technology and data capabilities into actionable commercial strategies

• Facilitate workshops and senior leadership sessions

• Develop recommendations, roadmaps, and implementation plans

• Contribute to Kvadrant’s thought leadership on AI-first commercial transformation

Who we are looking for

You have operated in a commercial or growth function and built or scaled GTM systems. You think in data, understand CRM and marketing technology, and know how AI is changing what is possible in B2B sales and marketing. You are ready to take what you know and apply it across a broader range of clients and challenges.

The ideal candidate:

• Has 2 to 4 years of experience in a growth, RevOps, commercial strategy, or GTM role, or from management consulting with a strong commercial technology focus

• Has hands-on experience with AI tools, CRM platforms, or marketing automation in a commercial context

• Is comfortable advising senior leaders and structuring complex problems

• Holds a master’s degree with strong academic results

• Thrives in a fast-moving, small-team environment with high ownership

• Holds a valid work permit for Denmark

• Is based in or willing to relocate to Copenhagen

What we offer

• Direct partner collaboration and client exposure from day one

• A practice that sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and applied AI

• A strong foundation in the management consultant toolbox: structured problem solving, project management, facilitation, and executive communication

• Clear development path, including partnership for top performers

• A collaborative, low-ego culture in central Copenhagen

• Flexibility and strong focus on work-life balance

Compensation

We offer a competitive package including base salary, performance bonus, options, and access to our equity programme through the Elixirr Group. The programme is designed to be genuinely meaningful, not a footnote.

Why Kvadrant

At Kvadrant Consulting, you join a small and ambitious team where learning happens through real responsibility and close collaboration.

What you can expect:

• Early responsibility and involvement in real client projects

• Close collaboration with consultants and partners, with ongoing feedback and sparring

• A strong focus on learning and development, both on and off projects

• A culture built on high ambition and low ego

• A flexible work environment that supports sustainable performance

• A welcoming office in the heart of Copenhagen

• An active social environment including team events, internal training, and offsites

Kvadrant is a place for people who want to learn fast, take responsibility, and help shape the future of commercial transformation.

Apply for the role

Please upload your CV, application, and transcript. If you’d like to learn more, reach out to Nønne Jørgensen at nbj@kvadrant.dk

jobs.occupation: Deck Officers with DP Unlimited and Strong English Skills for Dredgers
jobs.description:
Deck Officers with DP Unlimited and Strong English Skills for Dredgers

We are seeking skilled and motivated Deck Officers to join our modern fleet of Trailing Suction Hopper Dredgers operating on projects worldwide.

As a Deck Officer, you will play a vital role in the safe navigation, operation, and maneuvering of our vessels. Working in ports, coastal waters, and busy maritime environments, you will contribute to delivering complex dredging projects while maintaining the highest standards of safety, professionalism, and operational excellence.

You will become part of an international team where collaboration, innovation, and continuous development are highly valued.

Your Qualifications

We are looking for candidates who:

• Hold a valid Certificate of Competency as Master or Chief Mate, at least up to 3,000 GT

• Possess all required and valid STCW certifications

• Hold a valid DP Unlimited Certificate

• Have strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to a minimum B2 level (CEFR)

• Demonstrate professionalism and sound decision-making abilities

• Are proactive, reliable, and committed to maintaining high safety standards

• Can work independently while contributing positively to a multicultural team environment

• Thrive in a dynamic operational setting with varied challenges and responsibilities

• Are willing and prepared to take part in all required onboard operations, supporting both bridge and deck duties as operational needs require

It Will Be Considered an Advantage If You Have

• Previous experience on dredgers, offshore support vessels, or other DP-operated vessels

• Experience from dredging, offshore construction, marine engineering, or the fishing industry

• Experience working with international and multicultural crews

• Familiarity with advanced maritime equipment and vessel management systems

• Experience operating in coastal areas

What We Offer

• Permanent employment opportunities within a growing international organization

• Competitive salary and benefits package

• Equal-time rotation schedule (typically 3–4 weeks on/off)

• Comprehensive onboarding and vessel-specific training

• Opportunities for professional development and career progression

• Modern vessels equipped with advanced technology

• A supportive and professional working environment with strong teamwork both on board and ashore

• Diverse international projects and operational experience worldwide

Join Our Team

We are looking for dedicated maritime professionals who take pride in their work and are ready to contribute to the successful delivery of challenging marine projects.

If you are seeking a rewarding career with opportunities for growth, development, and international experience, we would like to hear from you.

NORTH is looking for talented students with business backgrounds who aspire towards a career within management consulting. As a Business Analyst, you will get the chance to work directly with our clients on diverse strategy and technology projects with a focus on sales and service operations.

Your responsibilities

As a Business Analyst, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers with extensive consulting experience, helping our clients solve their complex business issues from strategy to execution. Together with your team, you will be engaged in commercial transformation projects for a variety of clients, where you will act as an advisor in building solutions for business challenges in a sales and/or service context. You will typically be involved in all project phases, focusing on understanding business objectives and identifying possible solutions, which will rely heavily on technology, e.g., a Salesforce implementation or another CRM platform. Your responsibilities will be:

• 
Assisting in designing winning commercial strategies and delivering commercial excellence projects

• 
Conducting qualitative and quantitative analyses to identify, understand, and address client challenges

• 
Effectively visualising and communicating complex analyses to client

• 
Performing analyses of commercial processes in sales and service functions to define one global operating model

Your skills and experience

To succeed in the role, you have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Preferably, you have knowledge or experience with strategic management, commercial excellence, or sales- and service processes. As a person, you have a high level of drive and like to have a responsibility, where you continuously seek to improve the quality of your work. You are curious, learn to dare, and are comfortable in teams with an empathic mindset. You have the following skills and experience:

• 
You are studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business and have demonstrated a strong academic performance

• 
You have student job or internship experience from a consulting company or commercial experience from a C25 company

• 
You have a strong commercial mindset, seeking to improve sales and profitability

• 
You have an interest in working in the field between business and technology

• 
You can communicate complex problems and solutions in a simple understandable way, both verbally, in writing, and visually

• 
You have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with stakeholders at all levels

• 
You have excellent language skills in English

We expect you to be flexible and co-operative and can work independently under changing conditions. You should be able to work 2-3 days a week, however, we also understand that you must attend to and prioritise your studies, and we are aware that there will be times when assignments and exams occupy you. Furthermore, it’s possible to work full-time for a short or long period of time for example in between semesters.

What we offer you

We offer a challenging, dynamic, and welcoming environment, where you will get the opportunity to work with global transformation projects. You will get excellent development opportunities among highly competent and ambitious colleagues and leaders as well as regular mentoring and feedback to support your rapid development. You will work with a high degree of freedom and extensive responsibility while getting support from your team in an effort to become better at helping our clients create exceptional results continually.

You will get a unique opportunity to influence projects and your position in a rapidly developing environment. Last but not least, you will join a culture with a family vibe, a down-to-earth spirit, and a social gathering agenda.

How you apply

Please submit your motivational letter, CV, and university transcripts from your bachelor’s and master’s degrees. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews are arranged selectively.

To apply for this role, you must hold a valid work permit that allows for employment in Denmark and permits international travel on par with EU/EFTA citizenship rights.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

Our Business Development & Portfolio Management area has an ambitious strategy and we are looking for someone with a generic-pharma mindset or experience to drive the transformation and make sure we execute according to our plans, roadmaps and business goals within the area and along the value chain

About the job

This role is best suited for someone who knows how a generic pharma business operates. Compared with an originator company, we work with a broad portfolio, lean teams and short decision paths, and value comes from pragmatic, commercially minded execution.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive the transformation in the Business Development & Portfolio Management area from process changes to new ways of working

• Identify program impacts and design adoption measures together with functional leads

• Track adoption and take corrective action when change is not landing as planned

• Own the communication plan that keeps the organization informed and engaged

• Own the strategy execution roadmap for the Business Development & Portfolio Management area, ensuring alignment with Orifarm’s overall strategy and business goals

• Translate priorities into concrete program briefs, project charters, milestones and benefit maps

• Follow up on progress against plans and goals – with a single, transparent view of status, risks, dependencies and benefit realization

• Drive cross-functional coordination along the value chain – Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Business Development, Commercial and Operations – and ensure timely resolution of blockers

• Run the governance rhythm: program boards, track reviews and reporting to the Executive Management Group

You will report directly to our Chief Business Development & Portfolio Strategy Officer. You will present strategy updates and projects to our Executive Management Group and hold an explicit mandate to drive execution across the organization.

Who are you

We are looking for someone with significant experience driving transformations or programs in complex organizations, and a track record of making sure plans are executed and business goals are delivered.

Additionally, you will need to have experience from a generic or off-patent pharma business – across areas such as portfolio, business development, regulatory or commercial operations and you know how it differs from an originator company: broad portfolios, lean organizations, tight margins and pragmatic decision-making. Experience from a comparable commercial healthcare environment is also relevant.

You communicate clearly with executives, build alignment across functions, markets and cultures, and are comfortable challenging when progress stalls. You also ensure the right level of structure and governance for a regulated environment without building heavier processes than the business needs

Lastly, you have strong analytical skills, hold complexity across several concurrent workstreams and master program management methods and tools. A certification such as PRINCE2, MSP or PMI-PgMP is an advantage.

Who are we?

The Business Development & Portfolio Management area covers Portfolio Strategy, Business Development, Regulatory Affairs and Pharmacovigilance. You will partner closely with Strategy, the Strategy & PPMO Office, People & Culture and other corporate functions.

What we offer

• A role at the center of strategic decision-making, with direct access to the C-level and the Executive Management Group

• A clear mandate to drive execution across the organization

• An entrepreneurial culture that celebrates can-do attitudes, smarts and hearts, and a strong feedback culture that supports your development

• Flexibility and a strong commitment to work-life balance in an international setting with opportunities for growth

• A bonus scheme that includes every employee when we have good results

• A great canteen, massage service at our Odense office and social events throughout the year

Why should you join Orifarm?

At Orifarm, we are 2,300 employees united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted. It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

We encourage everyone to apply

At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

Job location

Odense, Denmark. You will work from our Odense office 2–3 days a week to be close to the majority of your stakeholders. We welcome candidates based outside Denmark who can commit to this whether by commuting or relocating (relocation support and expenses will be covered by Orifarm).

Application deadline

As soon as possible.
